# Mini Maker Game

> > A comprehensive coding education platform for kids featuring game-based learning, Minecraft modding tools, and curriculum aligned with K-12 standards.

Mini Maker Game is Tynker's primary educational hub for teaching coding to children through interactive games, Minecraft customization, and structured curriculum. The platform supports Python, JavaScript, and block-based coding with resources for both individual learners and school implementations.

## Key Topics

- Tynker platform
- Block-based coding
- Minecraft modding
- Python programming
- JavaScript
- Coding for kids
- Hour of Code
- AP Computer Science
- K-12 curriculum
- Game design
- STEM education
- Minecraft add-ons
- Educational standards
- AI introduction
- Visual programming

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Coding For Kids, Kids Online Coding Classes & Games](http://minimakergame.com/index9519.html): Tynker's online coding platform for kids with JavaScript, Python, and game-based learning
- [Coding for School: Teach K-12 Students to Code](http://minimakergame.com/index-14.html): Tynker's K-12 school coding platform with CSTA and AP Computer Science standards
- [Coding School for Kids](http://minimakergame.com/index-18.html): Tynker's K-12 school coding platform with FERPA and COPPA compliance
- [Coding Curriculum for Kids](http://minimakergame.com/index-12.html): Tynker's comprehensive coding curriculum with game design and AI introduction
- [Hour of Code | Coding Puzzles, AI and Games](http://minimakergame.com/index-10.html): Tynker's Hour of Code activities with coding games, puzzles, and AI projects

## Minecraft Modding & Customization

- [Minecraft - Ultimate Resource for Minecraft](http://minimakergame.com/index-3.html): Tynker's Minecraft modding and customization hub for skins, add-ons, and texture packs
- [List of Best Minecraft Mods 2023 - Minecraft Modpacks](http://minimakergame.com/index-5.html): Directory of Minecraft mods and modpacks with Tynker's visual modding language
- [Minecraft Add-Ons](http://minimakergame.com/index-8.html): Minecraft add-ons directory with community creations and editor tools
- [Minecraft Mobs - Find Popular and All New Mobs List](http://minimakergame.com/index-6.html): Minecraft mobs directory and editor for custom mob creation and deployment
- [Minecraft Blocks - All Minecraft Blocks List](http://minimakergame.com/index-9.html): Minecraft blocks directory and editor for custom block creation
- [Minecraft Items](http://minimakergame.com/index-7.html): Minecraft custom items editor and directory for weapons, armor, and tools

## Educational Resources & Curriculum

- [K8 Curriculum | Coding and STEAM Curriculum](http://minimakergame.com/index-15.html): Tynker's K-8 grade-specific coding and STEAM curriculum with block coding
- [Educator Training and Webinars](http://minimakergame.com/index-17.html): Tynker's educator professional development and AP Computer Science training
- [Hour of Code Teacher Guides and Answer Keys](http://minimakergame.com/teacher.html): Hour of Code teacher guides and answer keys with AI activities for grades 3-8
- [A Parents Guide on Coding](http://minimakergame.com/index-11.html): Parent guide to Tynker's self-paced coding courses with Python and AI
